# Duty Officer
Duty Officers are Security Officers specialising in the defense of the Brig and the management of prisoners.
1 . Standard [color=#00a933]Code Green[/color] equipment is:
2. Duty Officers report [color=#ffe100]directly to the Warden[/color], or the Head of Security if there is no Warden. The Duty Officer is to assist in the processing of prisoners.
3. Duty Officers are to directly communicate to the Warden at the start of the shift, and any time they are required to leave the department.
4. Duty Officers may perform the duties of a Security Officer with the Warden's approval, but [color=#ff0000]must[/color] comply with the SOP of Security Officers in doing so. In particular, Duty Officers may [color=#ff0000]not[/color] wear their riot gear outside the Security department unless the alert level is appropriate.
5. If performing standard Officer duties, Duty Officers [color=#00a933]may[/color] request a lethal sidearm. This sidearm is [color=#ff0000]not[/color] to be used in the Brig unless the alert level is appropriate.
6. Prisoner treatment guidelines are your [color=#ffe100]top priority[/color] and must be strictly followed. Non-lethal means should be used against prisoners whenever possible. Refer to the section on Prisoner Treatment for a further outline of your duties and expectations.
